title: From Porto’s City Hall to Vila Nova de Gaia: Portugal’s Hidden Stories
creator: Lisa Popple
description: A walk from City Hall at the top of Avenida dos Aliados down through the old town and across the Luís I bridge to the port lodges of Vila Nova de Gaia, with the stories and traditions that tie the two riverside cities together.

title: Art and Architecture: A Porto Walking Tour with Context
creator: Gabi Parker
description: A walk from Porto Cathedral through the city’s churches, theaters, and public spaces, looking at the tilework, Baroque carving, and buildings that show Porto’s long love of the arts.

title: Empire, Siege and the River Below: A Porto Self-Guided Walking Tour
creator: Anonymous Explorer
description: A walk through Porto’s medieval center down to the Douro, on the city’s place in Portugal’s empire, its Gothic churches, and the long siege of 1832–33 in Portugal’s civil war.
